description: This file contains utility classes and methods related to storage management in Apache Spark, including StorageStatus class for tracking block storage info and StorageUtils object with buffer disposal and shuffle service port retrieval functions.

classes.name: StorageStatus
classes.description: Class for managing storage information for each BlockManager, including block tracking, memory/disk usage, and storage levels.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Attempts to clean up a ByteBuffer if it is direct or memory-mapped, using unsafe API.

methods.name: externalShuffleServicePort
methods.description: Retrieves the port used by the external shuffle service, considering Yarn mode configurations.
